newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Whole Foods downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Whole Foods downgraded.

text.p: Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Wednesday it lowered its rating on Whole Foods Market Inc to a market performer from a buy-market outperformer, because of valuation and after its recently-announced merger plan.
-- Whole Foods, which owns a chain of natural food supermarkets, said it had a definitive agreement to acquire Amrion Inc for about $146 million.
-- Analyst Lynne Collier said in a research note said the merger was completely outside Whole Food's area of expertise. Amrion produces and markets nutritional products.
-- Amrion would have to build a new facility to service Whole Foods, which reduced earnings predictability, she said.
-- Shares had also reached her $29 to $31 per share target, she said.
-- Whole Foods stock was off 3/8 at 29-5/8. ((Wall Street desk 212-859-1610))
